summary: STRATS Trust for Goldman Sachs Capital I Securities, Series 2005-3 filed an 8-K reporting that a routine scheduled distribution was made to holders of its STRATS Certificates on September 15, 2026. The trust, a synthetic fixed-income vehicle holding Goldman Sachs junior subordinated debentures as its sole underlying assets, attached the trustee's distribution statement as Exhibit 99.1 with no dollar amounts specified in the excerpt. No other reportable transactions occurred. This is an ordinary pass-through distribution notice, not a special situation; watch for future cash-flow or credit events at the underlying Goldman debentures.
